messages:
clara: quick notes from design review today - main asks: clearer apply confirmation, inline diffs, localized copy, and accessible slider labels. dropping mock here: https://figma.redwood/capacity-confirm :mag_right:
jon: big +1 on inline diffs. users get nervous when several knobs change at once. show a compact diff row under the header: 'Min: 2 → 6  |  Max: 8 → 24  |  Burst: 0 → 30' with tiny revert chevrons
mei: confirmation modal should avoid scary billing language. suggestion: header 'Review and apply changes' body 'These changes may affect your monthly cost and quota. You can undo for 10s after applying.' primary CTA 'Apply changes' secondary 'Cancel'
rafa: localization note: currency formatting and decimal separators differ. use localized estimate like 'est. +24 /mo' rather than '$24' when language prefers unitless. also translate helper examples (e.g., 'e.g., +2 GPUs for 20 mins')
clara: accessibility: sliders need explicit labels like 'SLO: tail latency (ms) target' and aria-valuetext that combines value + unit. when preset applies, announce 'Preset latency-first applied, min increased to 6'
jon: small dev API snippet for activity log entry (for ops):
```
POST /api/v1/activity
{
  "actor": "clara",
  "action": "apply_capacity_change",
  "details": "min:2->6,max:8->24,burst:0->30"
}
```
rafa: on undo: make it a reversible client-side state until server confirm completes. show snackbar 'Changes applied. Undo?' with 10s countdown and 'View activity' link
mei: microcopy nits: prefer present-tense short descriptions for presets: 'Latency-first: increases minimum capacity to reduce tail latency.' 'Cost-optimized: lowers min and enables caching/batching.' keep lines <80 chars for i18n
jon: keyboard flow: allow Enter to open apply modal, then space to confirm. Esc cancels. focus trap in modal and initial focus on primary CTA. when revert chevrons used, make them accessible buttons with aria-label 'Revert min change from 6 to 2'
design-bot: created update 1757654360 44d https://figma.redwood/flow/1757654360 :white_check_mark:
rafa: ops-bot - can we surface quota warnings in-line, not just in modal? prefer subtle amber banner under diff row that says 'Quota may be approached' and an inline 'Request increase' action
ops-bot: noted. we'll expose quota_status (ok/near/block) on simulate endpoint and add a 'request_increase_url' in the response for quick modal prefill
clara: final asks before I hand to engineering: 1) inline diff row with per-field revert 2) soft confirmation modal copy + undo snackbar 3) localized short currency or unitless estimates 4) ARIA announcements for presets and simulator changes 5) analytics events: apply_click, undo_click, revert_field_click
jon: adding a small hover tooltip on steppers showing current adaptive step (+1/+5/+10) so users aren't surprised
mei: i'll run i18n checklist once comps land. thanks everyone - will tag infra & i18n and close when assets exported :rocket:
